portal CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml:56) runs 'bun run tsc --noEmit', which resolves portal/tsconfig.json -- a solution-style config with "files": [] and only project references. It therefore typechecks ZERO files and exits 0. Verified: 'tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json --listFiles' emits 0 lines. The real typecheck happens only inside 'bun run build' (tsc -b). The dedicated CI typecheck step is a no-op; package.json already has a correct 'typecheck' script (tsc -b --noEmit) that step could call. Not fixed -- outside TO scope, no action taken.

comp-transform schema-check returns rc=0 with 'Component not found' for any component outside portal/src/pages/**, so a mandated check on a src/components file reads as a pass while checking nothing. Separately, 'comp-transform schema-check Tooltip' silently fuzzy-resolves to a DIFFERENT component (ChartTooltip) and reports ITS verdict.

PROOF-OF-SPEC KIND ENUM GAP -- FOUND, ROUTED, AND FIXED AT THE ROOT WITHIN THE SESSION. This instance first failed artifact-coverage because the schema's `kind` enum had NO value for a frontend component, so .tsx files were declared `script` by necessity and were dragged into a heuristic keyed on the DS {firm}-{group}-{artifact}-{check} criterion-id grammar. Two instances failing identically on one cause identified it as template-level rather than authoring slips. Two one-line greens were available and BOTH were refused as false: declaring a covered artifact in declared_exclusions, and rewriting criterion ids to embed stems. CVO added `frontend_component` to the enum @8d77cd1537 (Rule 24 postulate (i) -- the enum was not collectively exhaustive) and annotated the check site so the skip cannot be misread as a gap. These artifacts are now declared with the honest kind and the check passes on a TRUE declaration, not an exception. The red was information; it held ~12 minutes and bought a permanent fix.
